gallery.title: File:Getty Villa exterior.jpg
gallery.description:
The outer Peristyle Garden of the Getty Villa Roman gardens, in Pacific Palisades, Los Angeles.  
The Getty Villa is designed to replicate an actual Ancient Roman villa buried in a volcanic eruption of Mt. Vesuvius.
The museum's exterior, gardens, fountains, statuary, and plants are reproductions of the Roman villa.  Statuary and art objects inside the museum are original works of art from the ancient Etruscan, Greek, and Roman cultures.
